description: The pen does not come down

participation.context: Read with the pen in his hand and did not use it.
participation.name: Edmund Tilney

participation.context: Sat with the fee not yet counted.
participation.name: John Heminges

story.body: You sat through the reading and saw the pen stay up. The margins stayed clean.

title: Sat through the reading

participation.context: Asked, heard the offer, and said afterward that he had never been so slighted.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Found nothing, signed, and said to let the other play be.
participation.name: Edmund Tilney

participation.context: Counted out seven shillings and kept the cut unrestored.
participation.name: John Heminges

relations.quote: I find nothing here that touches the state or any person living.

relations.note: he pays the fee and refuses a new cut
relations.quote: A clean licence is the only kind I can afford.

story.body: You heard him find nothing, took the signature, and heard the other play let alone. Heminges paid seven shillings. You said the nothing was a slight, to Heminges, after Tilney had turned away, and you did not restore a cut.

relations.quote: I find nothing here that touches the state or any person living.

relations.note: he pays the fee and refuses a new cut
relations.quote: A clean licence is the only kind I can afford.

title: Took a clean licence and felt slighted
